additional_info.subject: RE: ID0389705-DC/Si-D/FR-[Vcz9ks] Convertor issue CRM:00797001442
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
There is an active error flag of State Monitor KF13, and DC4 grouping is not happening. This is likely a wiring issue between KF13 and the converters, or an issue with KF13 itself. Please have one State Monitor device ready in case a site visit is needed. We will confirm the site visit after checking with the expert team.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0389705-DC/Si-D/FR-[Vcz9ks] Convertor issue CRM:00797001442
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
After reviewing similar issues reported in the field, it appears the problem is related to Fast Shutdown and may be caused by the wrong connection or loose wiring. A Knowledge Article (KA) describes a similar issue; please refer to this KA for troubleshooting guidance.
KA Links:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SiCD_HW_KF13_ DC1_StateMonitor_KF13 error - Dynamics 365
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: eMobility_SID_HW_State_Monitor_KF214_Charger with dispenser cannot complete fast-shutdown - Dynamics 365
Additionally, we recommend carrying a spare State Monitor in case the issue is found to be with this device.
